text: The dead-man switch is live (ran once on GitHub, green). If you send nothing for 72 h it asks 'still there?' by notification and chat; 24 h after that with no reply it turns the engine off, disables every workflow except its own watchdog, and blocks every Claude session and routine on all 3 accounts. Any message from you lifts it and re-enables what it turned off (the engine and trading switches stay off until you set them). The rule is in CLAUDE.md and research/coordination/DEADMAN.md. One limit: Claude's scheduled routines live outside GitHub, so it can't delete them, but they can't do any work while stopped.
